verdict.rationale: Jeeves's own Instant Pay page explicitly claims "TypeScript and Python SDKs" (jeeves-docs-17). The developer API platform it would wrap is documented (jeeves-docs-7, jeeves-docs-8), so official SDKs exist per the vendor. But this is a single marketing mention, possibly scoped to Instant Pay, with no SDK documentation or package details in the evidence. Missing for 10: SDK reference docs or install guides, package or repo names, coverage of the full API surface (cards, payments, expenses), independent or hands-on corroboration.
